reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: bought it because i received samples with my previous order. probably the best pdrn serum i tried so far. the formula is out of this world.
reviews.zh: 我係因為上次訂單入面有試用裝所以買嘅。可能係我試過最好嘅 PDRN 精華液。配方好出色。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: Sticky gel like texture, feels slight stinging on the skin when first applied. Doesn’t really absorb into the skin so feels like a layer on the skin the whole day
reviews.zh: 質地似黏黏嘅啫喱，第一次搽嗰陣皮膚有少少刺痛。唔係好吸收入皮膚，成日都好似皮膚面上有一層膜咁。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: I really love this product. The quality is consistently great, and it has become one of my favorites. I'm already restocking because it's so useful, and I will definitely purchase it again in the future
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款產品。質素一直都好好，已經成為我最愛嘅其中一款。因為好實用，我已經再次補貨，將來一定會再買。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: I didn't like the sticky effect. After applying the cream, the stickiness remained. I wanted to wash my face. Maybe I'm doing something wrong.
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意黏膩感。搽完面霜之後，黏膩感一直都在，我想洗面。可能係我做錯咗咩嘢。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: I love the gel cream texture to this moisturizer. I had no irritation & it absorbed quickly. I haven't used it regularly enough to notice any changes to my skin, but I like it a lot so far that I'll keep using.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款保濕霜嗰種啫喱霜質地。冇刺激，而且吸收好快。我未有經常咁用，所以未覺得皮膚有咩變化，但係目前已經好鍾意，所以會繼續用。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: One of my newly added skincare product, (when applying, it has a tingling sensation) i only tap the product on the creasing part of my skin and the post acne marks, then layer it after with a hydrating serum
reviews.zh: 係我新加入嘅護膚產品之一（搽嗰陣會有刺麻感）。我只係喺皮膚有細紋嘅位置，同痘印位置輕輕拍，然後再疊加一層保濕精華。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text: I usually love Numbuzin products but this one is not my favorite. It has a bit of an odd smell and leaves my skin quite sticky.
reviews.zh: 我通常好鍾意 Numbuzin 嘅產品，但係呢款唔係我最愛。味道有啲怪，用完皮膚都幾黏。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.2 Rose PDRN Collagen 2X Plumping Serum 30ml
reviews.text:
Wow! I was pleasantly surprised. The texture is amazing. I love the way it felt on my face.
Got a bit tingly too like as if I used reedle shot.
Will return for more surely.
reviews.zh:
哇！我好驚喜。質地好好，我好鍾意搽喺面上嗰種感覺。
搽完都有少少刺麻，好似用咗 reedle shot 咁。一定會再回頭買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
